notes: Adds weekly recording schedules, adjustable start/end padding, guide Record now and Stop/cancel actions, red recording dots, and a combined computer/device recordings list with automatic refresh. Includes visible Back buttons, group-switch persistence and a scrollable Settings menu. Recorder preview 0.2.0 is available for Windows and Linux at greenstreemlabs.com, with improved recovery from interrupted provider streams. Keep the recorder computer running; this device can be off after schedule confirmation. One MPEG-TS recording at a time.
